newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Von Roll takes provisions for steel row.
newsitem.headline: Von Roll takes provisions for steel row.

text.p: Von Roll Holding AG said it had taken provisions to cover potential risks in a dispute over the Gerlafingen steel plant it sold last year to Swiss steelmaker Von Moos.
Von Roll did not specify the amount of the provisions or any other details.
"We have made relevant provisions to cover our risks," Von Roll chairman Max Amstutz said in a copy of a speech released ahead of the group's annual news conference.
"For obvious reasons, we do not wish to make any declarations regarding the amount of these provisions," he said.

Von Roll last year sold its Swiss steelmaking activities, including the Gerlafingen plant, to Von Moos in a strategic move to get out of the troubled European steel sector and to concentrate on three core engineering businesses.
But Von Moos said it was pulling out of the deal retroactively, based on its claims that the Gerlafingen plant did not live up to standards promised by Von Roll.
The two companies are now trying to settle their dispute in an arbitration court.
"As is the case in many court proceedings, the outcome is unpredictable...but we calmly await the outcome of this affair," Amstutz said. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
